The business is restructuring its U.S. home care unit, Lincare, while still raising its dividend, which points to management prioritising both portfolio repair and consistent cash returns to shareholders. items.title: Is Linde (LIN) Reasonably Priced Given Its Earnings Strength?
items.summary: Linde has delivered strong returns in recent years, and with the stock last closing at US$526.55, the key question now is whether that price is supported by the company’s earnings power. Investors have a lot of good news to work with, but the real focus is how much of that story is already embedded in the current valuation.
